2125420907900314004.en_summary: A director of $COHR bought 82,000 shares at an average of $185.59, amounting to a $15.2 million personal purchase. Combined with the company's recently announced $2 billion buyback, both the board and the company are stepping in with real money amid market fear. Insiders sell for many reasons but only buy in size for one.
2125420907900314004.zh_summary: $COHR 一位董事以平均 $185.59 買入 82,000 股，個人購買金額達 1,520 萬美元。加上公司日前宣布的 20 億美元回購，董事會和公司本身都在市場恐懼中以真金白銀介入。內部人士出售有許多理由，但大量買入只有一個原因。

ticker_notes.COHR: 董事大額買入加上公司大額回購顯示強烈信心

2125417559067627973.en_summary: $MU $SKHY $DRAM Samsung's memory capacity for 2027 through 2029 is mostly under contract already per Korea's Economy Tribune. 2027 DRAM wafers effectively gone. Some customers want deals running to 2031. SK hynix DRAM and HBM effectively booked through 2029.

ticker_notes.MU: 記憶體產能長期被預訂，顯示供需持續緊張
